name: skillmesh
description: Native MCP App for mapping, confirming, installing, exporting, and using local Agent Skills.

interface.shortDescription: Map and use local Skills in your current Agent.
interface.longDescription: Open one native MCP App to map local Skills to workflows, record human decisions, control installation, export exact plans, and send a structured handoff into the current WorkBuddy or Codex conversation.
defaultPrompt: 打开 SkillMesh 工作台，查看当前工作流的 Skill 测绘。
在 SkillMesh 中确认 Skill 判断并生成即时使用方案。
用 SkillMesh 选择 Skill 并发送到当前 Agent 对话。
